name: Embed SharePoint OneDrive Library/Documents/Files
author: miniOrange

sections.description:
WordPress Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents plugin allows you to embed share OneDrive documents/files on your wordpress site. It also allows you to synchronize your sharepoint/OneDrive/Office365 user details / documents /files to the WordPress site. Your employees can create and view sharepoint OneDrive documents from the wordpress site.

The Embed SharePoint OneDrive Document plugin also allows effective file management of SharePoint OneDrive folders / Files / Media in your wordpress site using integrations with 3rd party plugins like BuddyPress, WooCommerce, MemberPress, Paid Membership pro, etc.

You can also use SharePoint onedrive Integrator plugin to configure Microsoft365/Office 365 apps like Power BI, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Dynamics CRM, Power Apps, Yammer, OneDrive, etc. with WordPress using Microsoft Graph APIs and User Sync for Azure AD/Azure B2C plugin for seamless Power BI integration, SharePoint integration, Dynamics CRM integration, and integration for other Office 365 apps.

You can check out the following video to embed the SharePoint/OneDrive documents on WordPress:

Use cases

Embed SharePoint Online Library Documents

  • Embed and display SharePoint Online library files directly within WordPress, supporting PDFs, images, videos, and other media types.
  • Use SharePoint documents as WordPress media files and integrate them with ACF media fields.
  • Control file access based on user domain, WordPress roles, usernames, or WooCommerce membership status.
  • Securely embed SharePoint files and folders with access restrictions tailored to WordPress users.

Embed SharePoint Online Folders in WordPress

  • Display SharePoint folders on any WordPress page or post using short Codes.
  • Restrict folder access based on user domain, WordPress roles, or WooCommerce membership plans.
  • Allow users to interact with SharePoint directories seamlessly within WordPress.

Advanced Access Control for SharePoint Files & Folders

  • Prevent direct access to SharePoint file URLs with dynamic masking via WordPress.
  • Restrict folder and document access with robust permission controls and WordPress authentication.
  • Define granular access rules to enhance security and compliance.

Automated WordPress Page & Post Management

  • Automatically create WordPress posts when new SharePoint documents are added.
  • Sync SharePoint tasks, comments, and lists with WordPress pages and posts.
  • Generate new WordPress users based on SharePoint list entries.
  • Manage WordPress custom post types based on SharePoint list updates.

Instant Notifications & Alerts

  • Notify users when new files are uploaded to SharePoint from WordPress.
  • Alert SharePoint teams or groups when a new post, page, or comment is created in WordPress.
  • Send automated notifications to WooCommerce members on relevant file updates.
  • Assign folders to users’ product lists based on their purchased subscriptions.

Shortcode Generator for Public & Restricted Views

  • Generate multiple shortcodes for embedding SharePoint files and folders into WordPress.
  • Customize access levels for each embedded SharePoint document or folder.
  • Provide seamless integration with WordPress pages while maintaining security controls.

Seamless Integration with Popular WordPress Plugins

  • Sync SharePoint files and data with Contact Form 7, Fluent Forms, Gravity Forms, and more.
  • Integrate with WooCommerce, WooCommerce Memberships, and WooCommerce Teams for
    document access control.
  • Compatible with MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Ultimate Members, and additional
    membership plugins.
  • Integrate with Ultimate members and many more.

Sync User Profiles, Sites from SharePoint

  • You can synchronize the user profile attributes like SharePoint About me, Skills, etc. to the WordPress Site.
  • Sync Office 365 Delve user profile attributes like About me, Skills, etc. to the WordPress site.
  • Synchronize user details from WordPress to SharePoint
  • Create new users in SharePoint once Registered in the WordPress

Advanced SharePoint File Search & Custom Views

  • Search for SharePoint files within WordPress using advanced search filters.
  • Perform full-text searches within SharePoint documents directly from WordPress.
  • Display SharePoint directories in thumbnail, grid (gallery), or table view formats.
  • Preview SharePoint files in pop-up mode or dedicated new tab.

SharePoint File Download & Preview Links

  • Generate secure download links for SharePoint files and embed them into WordPress posts.
  • Provide direct preview links for SharePoint documents within WordPress pages.
  • Enhance user experience with in-browser file viewing options.

Edit, Upload & Create SharePoint Files from WordPress

  • Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents plugin allows you to edit SharePoint files from your WordPress site.
  • Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents plugin allows you to Upload new files to the SharePoint storage from your WordPress site without need to store in WordPress database.
  • Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents plugin allows you to delete files / directories from the WordPress.
  • Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents plugin allows you to create files / directories from the WordPress.

Deep SharePoint Site Integration with WordPress

  • Retrieve and sync all SharePoint site data within WordPress.
  • Sync metadata from SharePoint to WordPress dynamically.
  • Synchronize SharePoint list items and metadata with WordPress pages.

SharePoint Social Feed & News Integration

  • Sync SharePoint social feeds like news and articles into the WordPress posts.
  • Automatically pull the latest SharePoint updates into a WordPress news section.

OneDrive & WordPress Integration

  • Upload WordPress attachments directly to OneDrive for seamless storage management.
  • Create new folders in OneDrive and manage files directly from WordPress.
  • Generate new text files in OneDrive from WordPress posts.
  • Search for OneDrive files and folders from within WordPress.

SharePoint and OneDrive File Sharing & Collaboration

  • Enable OneDrive file sharing for easy document collaboration within WordPress.
  • Provide team-based access to OneDrive documents directly from WordPress pages.
  • Securely manage OneDrive permissions from the WordPress dashboard.
sections.installation:
From WordPress.org

  1. Download miniOrange WordPress Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents plugin.
  2. Unzip and upload the WordPress Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate WordPress Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents from your Plugins page.

From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for WordPress Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents. Find and Install WordPress Embed SharePoint OneDrive Documents.
  3. Activate the plugin from your Plugins page.

For any query/problem/request

Visit Help & FAQ section in the plugin OR email us at info@xecurify.com or Contact us.
sections.faq:
I am not able to configure the plugin

Please email us at office365support@xecurify.com or Contact us. You can also submit your app request from plugin’s configuration page.

How to resolve “Token type is not allowed” error in the Documents/Files tab

This issue sometime may occur because new SharePoint subscription Grant App Permission is disabled by default. You can click here to resolve the issue.
